facts.function: identifies fuse positions/ratings in a vehicle fuse box

gri_path: GRI 1: candidate headings differ at 4/6-digit level depending on missing facts

rejected_alternatives.reason: fuse cards are not lighting/signaling equipment

missing_facts: What is the card made of (paper, paperboard, plastic)?
Is it printed matter (4911/4909) or a part or accessory of motor vehicles (8708, 8536.90)?
Does it carry electronics or fuses, or is it only a printed label/chart?
classification.rationale: A printed card could be printed matter of ch. 49, an article of paper, plastic article, or a vehicle part; material and function are not given, so I abstained.
